events.title: PatchFest Updates!
events.summary: I've been working hard to deliver new updates throughout NextFest! There's still a long road ahead, and many of the features suggested by players are yet to come. events.title: Environment Overhaul update for the Demo!
events.summary: I've just pushed a major environment overhaul, updating almost all of the nature assets in the demo. While it's not aiming for AAA-level visuals, the goal is to create a more immersive atmosphere while still leaving a little room for imagination.Thank you all for the continued feedback and support! I'm paying close attention to what players are saying, and I'll do my best to prioritize the changes that align with the community's overall feedback.I'm also leaning toward delaying the full release

events.title: Demo Updates!
events.summary: Thanks to all the feedback and reports from the demo launch! I've been pushing updates quickly over the past couple days and wanted to document them for clarity. This biggest issue is that some users had Mouse control/DPI issues on Windows. The new build starts the game up in Fullscreen Windowed (borderless) mode to sidestep this issue.
